notes.title: New Toy Trains Update!
notes.content:
Hey Hey Hey! 
We have just published a new update to the Game! And it's biiig! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/bcec153ee73296c95163b27d2fcac91047a631a6.gif

As a response to all your requests, Toy Trains will now allow you to:

 Pass objects from one hand to another
 Access settings page, and adjust them up to your will
 Make saves
 Play in the guest mode
 Observe better wagon physics
 Change the cat for the dog (We know you have waited for this one!)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/22bb2e065f9387e56a6fa7f47f99fbf7c38317f1.gif

Also, the vanishing hands bug has been fixed (thanks again for letting us know about it!), coherent PS highlight effect has been added as well as better terrain generation and a slightly different way of appearing of new buildings on the board.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/6a4b4e93b4de5b4f702649422fac0eeddabe6097.gif

See? It’s all big changes but we are very excited to keep making Toy Trains better for you! Go check all the updates directly in the game, but make sure to come back here soon as we will have even more news to share. Choo choo!

notes.title: Toy Trains Demo Update!
notes.content:
How’s your VR Steam Fest going? 

There’s so many games featured here this year- thanks a lot for taking the time to check out Toy Trains VR! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/cb5f7d514dfa28e44bc1b99784890024631116d4.gif

Even though Toy Trains premieres on 16th of January - there’s a free Demo available here on Steam - and especially for the VR Fest occasion we decided to update it just as we updated the full game. 

We’ve added the following features:


 saves!   
 new hands
 more precise and intuitive grabbing
 narrator is more helpful
 throwing feels like actual throwing
 falling feels like actual falling
 121 other tweaks and improvements that are too long to list here 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/77aa1197e0789481adddf6fe4df19e70b4660d55.gif

It’s pretty exciting, and we’re very curious about your thoughts on the demo. Remember that the full game is about to be even more fun!

notes.title: Hop on board for Demo ride and join Toy Trains family!
notes.content:
Do you like relaxing experiences and games that make you stretch your imagination? Or maybe you think that there is not enough lovingly polished, high quality experiences on VR? You can’t find something to play for you, your significant other, friends, parents or grandparents? 

We had this problem as well- and we decided to solve it! 

Toy Trains VR is an outcome of our dedication to create games that are well made and enjoyable for everyone. It’s a cozy, creative game with wholesome vibes and open-ended challenges. It connects buildings (duh) and also generations. It’s a great, modern way to relieve your childhood’s happy times. 

Play the Demo, share it with your friends and close ones to invite them to the cozy Toy Trains Land! You can also join our Discord and become one of the first members of our community! 

Ah, also - we made the demo even better for you! What’s new?


 the game crashes a little bit less
 we moved narrator buttons 12 pixels to the right (it makes a big difference- trust us)
 we broke the Vinyl Player (oopsie!)
 shiny effects are even more shiny
 we have Railies statues now!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44513456/27f724b241a6550f23338c97aba0a2a469c53245.png

We’re constantly working on making the game even better and won’t stop until its release in December (and beyond!).

See you then!
